summary.text: Use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service if you do not wish to keep your cover.

details.heading: What to consider before ending cover
details.body: You will lose all existing benefits. If you later wish to join CareShield Life, you may have to go for a medical assessment. MOH encourages you to keep your policy for basic protection for long-term care.

steps.name: Use the termination e-Service
steps.text: If you do not wish to continue to be covered under ElderShield, use the Termination of ElderShield e-Service.

sources.page_title: How do I terminate my ElderShield policy?

quotes.text: You can terminate your ElderShield via the Termination of ElderShield e-Service if you do not wish to continue to be covered under the scheme.

However, you will lose all existing benefits, and you may have to go for a medical assessment if you wish to join CareShield Life. We encourage you to consider keeping your ElderShield policy to ensure you continue to have basic protection for long-term care.
